I strongly oppose burning the treasury. Tom, I understand your position as accepting Silicon Valley funding through US-regulated SWIFT transfers and investor control over developers, while rejecting a nonprofit that would hold the same funds responsibly and use the same payment channel to fund new developers impartially.
